name: Mount Zabool
title: Mount Zabool
summary: The smallest of the three mesas (about 100 x 115 m at 224 m), reached only through Zabool Tower; its summit carries a Life Stone, the Top of Zabool Tower portal and, at the south end, the portal to Mount Alphus. Its sides drop 110-170 m.

site.name: Mount Zabool
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer top-of-mt-zabool (summit, 17 m from the centre).

shots.standingOrder: Start 7 m from the Life Stone on the Zabool summit at 2.5 m height and pull back north-north-east in one line to 54 m out and 26 m up; nothing on the mesa top is within 45 m.
shots.notes: Backlit dronie: the Life Stone on Zabool's 224 m summit glows against the low south-west sun (0.60) as the camera pulls back north-north-east and climbs; the small summit plateau shrinks and the plains and Mount Alphus's pillar open behind the stone.
